source.from: 原创配方（R11 为补日式动画而写，公开名称不用人名与工作室名）

essence: 通透发光的动画背景美术
壮阔天空、积云、光束与镜头光晕
深饱和的蓝与暖金色光的对比
干净的动画人物线稿，人物常在广阔空间里

recipe.positive: Visual style (follow exactly): in the style of Makoto Shinkai (Your Name, Weathering with You). Luminous photoreal anime background art: breathtakingly detailed, hand-painted-looking scenery with dramatic skies full of towering cumulus clouds, sunbeams and lens flare, glittering light on wet surfaces, deep saturated blues against warm golden light, crisp clean anime character line art with small figures inside vast spaces, cinematic wide framing, emotional and nostalgic atmosphere. Objects, rooms and close-ups keep the same luminous anime rendering with clean line art, never plain photography.
recipe.text_style: Any title is clean, elegant lettering set in the sky or open space, like a film title card.

colors.name: 暗部深棕 deep shadow brown
暖光奶白 warm light cream
深石板蓝 deep slate blue

must_see: luminous, highly detailed anime background art with dramatic light
expressive sky or light effects such as clouds, sunbeams, glow or glittering reflections
contrast between cool blues and warm golden or apricot light
clean anime line art on any characters
must_not_see: flat vector or simple cartoon rendering
plain photographic look without anime line art

drifts.symptom: 室内近景与静物失去动画感、像照片
drifts.fix: 锁定层已补一句：物件、房间与近景同样保持发光动画画法与干净线稿

inspiration.prompt: Makoto Shinkai (Your Name, Weathering with You)

motion_dialect.language: 镜头或景深层缓慢横移，整体舒展有电影感；画面原本有云层、光束或湿润表面时，才让它们做分层视差或轻微闪烁，不为了动效新增天气、湿地面或光束。
motion_dialect.safety: 人物、产品与文字不形变；光扫避让受保护节点，不遮挡主体信息，只调整亮度，不改变冷蓝与暖金的色相关系；首末帧完整可读。
